remarks: Seller is asking for all offers to be submitted by Tuesday at noon. This stunning almost "NEW" construction home in the highly desirable Mid-City neighborhood of Stamford offers the perfect combination of luxury, comfort, and convenience. Upon entry, you're greeted by a spacious living room with 9+ ft ceilings, rich wood floors and a cozy fireplace. The living area seamlessly flows into the dining room and eat-in kitchen, creating an open, inviting space perfect for both daily living and entertaining. The kitchen is the heart of the home, featuring high-end stainless steel appliances, including a gas range, quartz countertops, and stylish tiled backsplash. A breakfast island offers additional space for meal prep and casual dining. The dining room has a sliding door that opens to a deck. Lower level has a cozy family room with a 2nd fireplace which sets the tone for relaxation, this level also includes a bedroom, full bath, and sliders leading out to a large patio, overlooking a half-acre backyard ideal for hosting guests or enjoying peaceful outdoor moments. Upstairs, the impressive primary suite is a true retreat, featuring its own full bathroom and two generous closets. Adjacent to the master are three additional spacious bedrooms and another full bath with a double vanity-providing ample space for family and guests. Located just minutes from the train, downtown Stamford, Whole Foods, Shack Shack, Starbucks and so much more. Scalzi Park, I-95, and the Sterling Farm Golf.
